description: Full-surface analysis of a public website, API or shipped JS bundle: maps the capabilities it exposes, its entry points and feature flags, with the evidence behind every claim, and lists what could not be determined. Read-only; a 401/403 is recorded as auth_required and never bypassed. Input: {"url": "https://example.com"}. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.02 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。

focus.description: Optional: what you want to learn, e.g. "how do I call their API"

target.description: Alternative: a local file path (app.asar, *.exe, *.so, *.apk). The analysis cannot run server-side, so a ready-to-run runbook is returned instead

url.description: Public https URL to analyze (website, API or MCP server)

name: buy_rea_report
